table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	currlistrow = 0,
	stock     = 0.0000, 
	totalstock= 0.0000, 
	TD.transcode,
	TD.icode,  
	I.customicode,  
	TH.posted,
	TH.dgcode,
	remarks=max(TH.remarks),
	TH.sgcode,
	sourcegodown=(SELECT  GC.NAME FROM GODOWN GC WHERE GC.GCODE=TH.sgcode),
	targetgodown=(SELECT  GD.NAME FROM GODOWN GD WHERE GD.GCODE=TH.dgcode),
	itemname = I.name, 
	Id   = TD.IDENTITYCOL,
	requiredqty =MAX(TD.RequiredQty),
	reorderqty = MAX(TD.ReorderQty) ,
	optimumqty = MAX(TD.OptimumQty ),
	targetstk = SUM(TD.targetstock),
	sourcestk = SUM(TD.sourcestock),
	qty  = sum(TD.qty),
	headerno=max(TH.headerno),
	saleprice=(max(TD.saleprice)/ISNULL(max(TD.packunits),1)),
	batch=max(TD.batch),
	expiry=min(TD.expiry),
	savedate=TH.date,
	PostDate=TH.postdate
FROM 
	tdetail TD, theader TH, item  I
WHERE 
	( TH.transcode = :ar_tCode ) AND
	( TD.transcode = TH.transcode ) AND
	( TD.icode = I.icode )
GROUP BY 
	TD.transcode, 
	TH.sgcode,
	TH.dgcode,
	TH.posted,
	TH.date,
	TH.postdate,
	TD.icode, 
	I.customicode, 
	I.name,
	Id
ORDER BY 
	Id

objects.name: posted
objects.format: case(  posted  when "Y" then '(Posted)' when "N" then '(UnPosted)')
